stem: During a profile review, a licensed pharmacy intern is scheduled without a pharmacist preceptor physically or professionally directing the work. Select all supported conclusions.

choices.text: In this setting, a senior technician may replace the pharmacist preceptor.
On this record, the intern must work under direct supervision of a registered pharmacist preceptor.
At this stage, the intern may verify prescriptions independently after 500 hours.
For this scenario, intern status does not authorize independent pharmacist practice.
Under these facts, the pharmacist preceptor remains responsible for the direct-supervision relationship.
